:::{#hero-heading}

<p style="text-align: justify;">I am [Croucher Postdoctoral Fellow](https://croucher.org.hk/en/fellows-and-scholars/jeffery-chan?page=1) at UC Berkeley, working with [Albert Ruhí](https://ruhilab.org/) to investigate how extreme events are reshuffling diadromous fishes. Before this, I was a Postdoctoral Scholar (as Visiting Associate Specialist) at UC Santa Barbara, where I worked with [Rafael J.P. Schmitt](https://es.ucsb.edu/people/rafael-jp-schmitt) on optimizing sustainable hydropower and riverine connectivity. I earned my PhD working with [David Dudgeon](https://www.biosch.hku.hk/ecology/dd.htm) and [Jia Huan Liew](https://discover.utas.edu.au/JiaHuan.Liew) on the impacts of fragmentation by dams on diadromous species at The University of Hong Kong. Prior to my academic journey I founded [Freshwater Collective](https://www.freshwatercollective.org), a conservation organization with the aim of bridging the gap between research and education of freshwater ecology.</p>
